Good Hope (native 2.1.7b) cannot target enemies (self/friend only) and applies only GoodHopeBuff through its own allied AbilityTargetsAround: +2 morale on attack, weapon damage, saves, skills and ability checks (AddStatBonus, BuffAllSavesBonus, BuffAllSkillsBonus, BuffAbilityRollsBonus). Its EffectOnAlly = Harmful metadata is misleading; the discovered graph (allied area, Crushing Despair removal branch) is kept.
